script: [0:00–0:03]  HOOK — 'Watch us fix a broken website in real time'
[0:03–0:08]  Introduce the topic: Behind the Scenes — Building Something
[0:08–0:16]  Point 1: We received a client site that had broken images, no SSL certificate, and a contact form that was sending emails to nowhere for 6 months.
[0:16–0:24]  Point 2: We opened the code, found the bug in the form handler, fixed the SSL, compressed all images, and the site went from 8 seconds load time to under 2 seconds.
[0:24–0:32]  Point 3: The client had no idea any of this was happening.
caption:
Watch us fix a broken website in real time

We received a client site that had broken images, no SSL certificate, and a contact form that was sending emails to nowhere for 6 months.

We opened the code, found the bug in the form handler, fixed the SSL, compressed all images, and the site went from 8 seconds load time to under 2 seconds.

The client had no idea any of this was happening.
